messages:
Maya K: Hey team — want to spin up a focused one-pager + webinar plan that ties our deployment modes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) to enterprise concerns: SLAs, security controls, and inbound routing playbook. Goal: field-ready asset for AE/SE handoffs by next Tues.
Jordan P: +1. Do we want separate one-pagers per deployment mode or a single matrix?
Maya K: Lean single matrix one-pager (1 page) + 1-slide follow-up for each mode for webinars. Keep the one-pager customer-facing, short bullets and a small benchmark callout.
Sam R: For benchmarks — we have 99th percentile latency numbers for hosted vs dedicated vs private from last quarter. Can pull numbers by EOD.
Elaine T: I'll draft the security section: KMS/HSM, VPC peering, audit logs, SOC2 details. Need to confirm which HSM vendors we list.
Maya K: Good. Include fallback behaviours (smart routing + model variants) under reliability/SLA. Sales asks for clear escalation path and sample SLA language.
Jordan P: For inbound routing: include quick decision tree: "low latency -> hosted; predictable throughput -> dedicated; regulated data -> private". Also note cost levers (batching/quantization) with simple arrows.
Sam R: Adding a 2-line benchmark blurb: "Across internal evals, Dedicated reduced median latency by 20% at steady throughput vs Hosted; Private shows parity when colocated." Want exact numbers?
Maya K: Yes — please add exact median and p95 for each mode, and a short note about hardware assumptions (GPU type) — keep it non-techy.
Elaine T: Draft security blurb done: two bullets + a "what to ask your infra team" checklist. Pushing to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/example-sec-onepager (mock link).
Jordan P: Webinar plan idea: 30-minute live session — 10m product, 10m benchmarks/bench Q&A, 10m customer ask + routing playbook. Invite Sales & SE for 1:1 follow-ups.
Maya K: Love it. Can Marketing own the slide deck + landing page? SEs to provide quotes + SOC2 blurbs.
marketing-bot: Reminder: weekly backlog grooming in 3h — add "enterprise one-pager" to marketing sprint. :bell:
Sam R: I'll drop benchmark table and source CSV in the drive by EOD.
Maya K: Folks — timeline: draft by Fri COB, internal review Mon, finalize Tues morning for AE pack. If anyone can't meet, ping.
Elaine T: On it.
Jordan P: Will prep webinar copy and AE handoff script.
Sam R: Sending numbers now. :email:
